title: answers streaming projection (v1)
description: The stable projection of one successful streamed answers run inside the buffered JSON envelope's data.projection: the assembled answer text (omitted when the stream offered none), the delta count, and the citation and entity projections in arrival order.

answer.$comment: The concatenation of every emitted text delta; omitted when the stream carried no answer text.

delta_count.$comment: The answer_delta runs the stream emitted.
